sentences.text:
And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay
Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vinay Shankar Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.allowed 1.
Heard Sri Sanjay Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Jai Prakash, learned AGA for the State.
2. The instant application seeking anticipatory bail was filed on 12.12.2021.
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged by the informant Smt. Manju Singh, who was a guarantor for the loan taken by the applicant from Canara Bank.

On 04.04.2023,
this Court had passed following order granting interim bail to the applicant:-
"Heard Shri Sanjay Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicants, Shri Vinay Shankar,
learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.3 as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
The instant application has been moved by the accused-applicants- Anwar Ahmad @
Anwar and Mohd. Amir, in Case Crime No. 389 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420,
467, 468, 471 and 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Jagdishpur, District Amethi, with the prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail, as they are apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.
Learned counsel for the applicants while referring to the first information report as well as the petition which has been filed by the opposite party no.3, namely, Canara Bank before the Debt Recovery Tribunal at Allahabad specifically Para No. 5.6 and 5.7 of it, vehemently submits that it is admitted to the 'Bank' that the defendant no.3 before the Debt Recovery Tribunal at Allahabad (Informant of the instant case) has herself submitted the original title deeds to the 'Bank' on 26.12.2020 on which the equitable mortgage has been created with regard to the property in question and also that the original title deeds were also submitted by the informant to the 'Bank' and the instant F.I.R. has only been lodged in order to avoid her liability to pay the amount as the liability of a guarantor to pay the loan is co-terminus with that of the principal debtor.
It is also submitted that applicants are co-operating with the investigation and appearing before the investigating officer as and when their presence is required and they undertakes that they will continue to co-operate in the investigation and would Anwar Ahmad Alias Anwar And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148760777/
1 remain present before the investigating officer as and when their presence would be required even for discovery of any fact as warranted under Section 27 of the Indian Evidence Act or for any other purpose.
It is further submitted that applicants are not having any criminal history and since they are ready to co-operate in the investigation, protection from arrest be granted to them.
Learned A.G.A. on the other hand opposes the prayer of anticipatory bail of the applicant on the ground that applicants are not co-operate in the investigation, thus,
they are not entitled for any discretion.

sentences.text:
Shri Vinay Shankar, learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.3 namely Canara Bank, has drawn the attention of this Court towards the Para No. 5.6 and 5.7 of the petition filed by the 'Bank' before the Debt Recovery Tribunal, Allahabad as well as with regard to the recovery of loan and stated that it was the informant herself filed the title deeds of his property on which the equitable mortgage was created.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it appears that pertaining to the non-payment of loan which was taken by the applicants, the Canara Bank has filed a petition before the Debt Recovery Tribunal,
Allahabad, which is admittedly pending before the Debt Recovery Tribunal,
Allahabad.

It is in Para No. 5.6 and 5.7 of the petition, a copy of which has been brought on record by the applicants, it is stated that the defendant no.3 (Informant of the instant case) had signed a letter evidencing deposit of title deeds and confirmed that she has deposited with the applicant- Bank on 26.12.2020, the original title deeds with intend to create security by way of equitable mortgage by deposit of title deeds.
Thus, having regard to the averments made by the Canara Bank in Para No. 5.6 and 5.7 of the petition filed before the Debt Recovery Tribunal, Allahabad, In the considered opinion of this Court, protection from arrest for a limited period of time may be granted to the applicants.
Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 returnable within three weeks.
Steps in this regard be taken by learned counsel for the applicants within 02 working days from today.
List this case on 25th April, 2023, on which date this application shall be finally disposed of.
Till the next date of listing, the State may also file counter affidavit/objections with regard to the prayer of anticipatory bail of the applicant.

sentences.text:
As an interim measure, it is provided that till the next date of listing, in the event of arrest of the accused-applicants namely, Anwar Ahmad @ Anwar and Mohd. Amir,
involved in the above noted case, they shall be released forthwith on anticipatory bail on their furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- and two sureties eacallowedh in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the Police Station concerned/ Investigating Officer/Trial Court subject to the following conditions:-
(1) The applicants within one week from today shall appear before the investigating officer or in absence of investigating officer before the S.H.O. of the police station concerned and would furnish their mobile phone numbers to the investigating officer or the S.H.O. concerned, as the case may be and shall remain present before the investigating officer as and when their presence would be required and will co-operate in the investigation.
The office has reported that the notice issued to the opposite party no. 2 has been served on the informant but the informant has not put in appearance to oppose the application.
No counter affidavit has been filed either by the State or by the bank.
5. Learned A.G.A. could not point out any violation of the conditions imposed in the order dated 04.04.2023 granting interim anticipatory bail to the applicants.
6. In view of above, the interim order dated 04.04.2023 is made absolute and the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

7. The anticipatory bail granted to the applicants shall continue during the pendency of the trial,
unless any contrary order is passed as per the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Sushila Aggarwal v. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1.
